entry.title: the ways of the old, old winds blowin' back round
entry.summary:
Author: habituallywastingtime

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 45,144Chapters: 7/16Kudos: 122

Summary: As a child, Arthur didn’t know why he was kept away from the courtyard. Or why it so often smelt… like that. Until one morning, Sir Kay guided him to the balcony he’d only been allowed on sometimes. Only sometimes, because it looks over the courtyard. His father was waiting for him, holding an arm out to beckon him closer. Arthur rushed in, latching himself onto his father’s side as it was so rarely permitted. There was a crowd below him; he had never seen so many people in one place. There was a pile of wood. He remembers little outside of the way his eyes burned, how he at last understood that smell. He remembers forcing down his supper that night and emptying his stomach in the corridor before he could even reach his room. Now he remembers it all. He can’t feel the bruising stones under his knees, hardly tastes the leftover bile coating his mouth. All he knows is the all-consuming realization that his greatest fear and anguish still holds the throne, even in his heart.  sequel to the pale morning sings of forgotten things

entry.title: He is half of my soul, as the poets say
entry.summary:
Author: To_spin_a_yarn

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 42,845Chapters: 7/?Kudos: 117

Summary: “My lord?” Gaius called. Arthur swallowed hard before turning around. “Yes?” he replied, his voice strangely neutral, far too clear for someone who felt as though his chest were being crushed from the inside. “I need you to tell me in detail what happened” the physician said. The effort to remain professional was obvious, to keep from showing the despair that must have been consuming him at the sight of his nephew in such a state. “There’s nothing to tell” Arthur said far too quickly, as though he wanted to end the matter before it gained any weight. “He was completely normal one second, and the next he was groaning in pain, with his eyes…” he made a vague gesture with his hand, unable to finish. Giving it shape would make it real, and he was not sure he could bear it. What difference did it make now? He’s dead, a cruel part of his mind whispered. “Then his eyes rolled back and he… fainted.” ⸻ Or: where Merlin’s soul travels back in time while fighting in the midst of the Second World War, and, in the process, his body in Camelot dies for a few minutes, sending Arthur Pendragon to the verge of fainting.

entry.summary:

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 82,345Chapters: 6/54Kudos: 71

Summary: King Uther is dead. Long live the king.When an old enemy crawls from the grave and cuts Uther down, an inexperienced and grieving Prince Arthur is forced to take the throne. As king, Arthur will be tested by regular magical attacks, his father's conservative council, and his own self-doubt. Yet he faces an even greater foe: Uther's shadow stretches long and dark across the land of Camelot, and if Arthur wants to forge a golden future for his people, he must first unravel the sins of the past.Merlin is used to living in shadow, but serving the new king thrusts him out into the light. Torn between a need for secrecy and his budding friendship with Arthur, Merlin does his best to protect Camelot the only way he knows.But no one can hide forever in a place they call home. Arthur lacks his father's zealotry, but he's no friend to magic either. Can Merlin hold on long enough to soften Arthur's heart? Or will he be forced to spend the rest of his life fleeing the way he fled Ealdor, too strange and wild to ever feel safe?Or;BBC Merlin if Kilgarrah never whispered destiny in Merlin's ear.

Summary: ~ "I told you," he choked out, his voice a fierce growl right against Merlin's skin. "I am your shield." ~─── If the end of Merlin left you with a "Once and Forever Broken Heart", this is the story you were denied. As Merlin defies destiny to drag Arthur back from death, what they uncover is far more than a magic reveal. Driven by a devotion that shatters ancient prophecies and burns through Merlin’s soul, their fight leaves the raw truth of their feelings laid bare. Through an intimate, psychological, and epic path, they learn to navigate this new reality together. This is the journey of two men stepping beyond unspoken devotion into an absolute belonging—a bond growing from destiny to mind, from soul to skin, and deep into flesh and bone. It unfolds through the most subtle touch, the pure truth of their hearts, and the monumental choices shaping their realm. Healing is a gradual journey—from individual sacrifice to a kingdom rebuilding as a whole. Expect a fiercely protective King, a Court Sorcerer by his side as an equal, a rich slow-burn convergence of souls, and the unsparing emotional and physical payoff we were always promised.
